label_taster_time_up_label: Time is up. This round is closed.
label_taster_one_away_label: Close. One is in the wrong set.
label_taster_pending_note: Your board is locked. Results mark your cards as they come in. Tap a card to see what it means.
label_taster_rank_unavailable: The leaderboard is not answering just now.
label_taster_board_empty: Nobody has finished this round yet. Play it and you are first on the board.
label_taster_ranked_by: Ranked on lines. Every line that comes in scores, and a full board scores on top of them. Nothing is ranked until the results are in.
label_taster_refused: That did not go through. Try again.
label_taster_refused_finished: You have already finished this round.
label_taster_refused_too_many_wrong: That is too many wrong for this round.
label_taster_refused_no_picks: You have used every pick for this round.
label_taster_refused_incomplete: Answer every question before sending it.
label_taster_refused_one_at_a_time: One at a time on this board.
label_taster_refused_moved: The round changed while you were playing. Here it is again.
label_taster_unavailable: This one is not on yet.
label_taster_loading_state: Picking up where you left off
label_taster_how_to_play: Choose a board before kick-off. Cards mark themselves as confirmed match events come in. Complete a row, column or diagonal to score. The centre square is free.
label_taster_foot_note: Every word on this page can be changed by whoever runs the game, with no developer and no release. The answers stay on the server.
label_taster_proofs_heading: Don't take our word for it
label_taster_proofs_blurb: The answers were never in this page. Here are four ways to check for yourself, and none of them is part of the game.
label_taster_look_label: See what the page was sent
label_taster_payload_note: What the server did not send:
label_taster_needs_play: Have a go first, then this sends that same answer again.
label_taster_not_capped: This game has no limit set, so nothing stopped you.
label_taster_notify_title: Notify me when the results are in
label_taster_notify_mock_note: This is a demonstration. Nothing you type is stored, and nothing is sent.
label_taster_notify_done: Nothing was saved. On a real game this is where the result would find you.
label_taster_bingo_flip_hint: Tap to see what this means
how_to_play: Choose a board before kick-off. Cards mark themselves as confirmed match events come in. Complete a row, column or diagonal to score. The centre square is free.
consent_detail: {brand} would like to record analytics on how you play, so we can improve the game. We only do this if you agree. Data needed to run the game, such as your scores, is processed on the basis of legitimate interests.
signin_detail: Your scores in this game count on your Gamestage account.
label_taster_bingo_choose_note: Compare your boards, then lock your favourite. You cannot swap after locking.
label_taster_bingo_watch_note: Your board is locked. Results mark your cards as they come in. Tap a card to see what it means.
recovery_show_detail: Save this code. It brings your name, scores and achievements back on another phone or browser. You only see it once.
recovery_private_note: Keep it private. Anyone with this code can play as you.
recovery_replace_note: Getting a new code stops the old one working.
recovery_enter_detail: Type the recovery code you saved to get your progress back.
recovery_not_recognised: That code isn't one we know. Check it against the one you saved.
recovery_restored: Welcome back. Your progress is on this device now.
recovery_issue_failed: That didn't work. Check your connection and try again.
